name: amplify-leucomyst-bp
about: v0.120.0: {{Amplify|Leucomyst +1000}} = for each Leucomyst family Spirit you control, during this battle, this Spirit gains +1000 BP. Meztaurus (26RBS01-051) attacks with a second Leucomyst (26RBS01-048) on the field and uses Amplify (pay one cost): +2000 BP this battle.
